candidate_robustness.matched_random: same month, D1 regime, ATR quintile and LONG direction; 2000 replications; exact execution and one-position accounting

meta_fakeout_detector.candidate_source: Union of EXPANDING and exponential-decay HL3/6/12/24 previous-month-P90 signals
meta_fakeout_detector.entry: exact M1 open after the confirmation M15 bar closes
meta_fakeout_detector.execution: SL1.0 ATR, TP2.0 ATR, 480 exact M1 bars, 22.5 USD spread, SL-first collision
meta_fakeout_detector.training: monthly expanding; only candidate outcomes resolved before refit
meta_fakeout_detector.selection_gate: at least 20 discovery trades, active in both 2024H2 quarters, PF >= 1.10, net positive
meta_fakeout_detector.support_gate: 2025 at least 30 trades, active both halfyears, PF >= 1.0, net positive; combined PF >= 1.15; at least 2 of 3 halfyears positive; bootstrap positive probability >= 0.75

forbidden: using original outcome labels as features
using current-month outcomes in training or thresholds
post-result month, direction, D1 or volatility deletion
Shadow, Discord, MT5 orders or live-ready promotion
